assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque painterly background plate for a talent tree in the original MMO-inspired Luanti game Grudgelands. Wide horizontal canvas, aspect 1040:440 (26:11), compose for exact final 1040 x 440 pixels. Shared collection style: restrained atmospheric gouache and oil brushwork, broad graphic silhouettes, tactile matte surfaces, soft depth, elegant muted fantasy illustration. The middle 80 percent of width, across the FULL height, must be dark-to-mid value very low-detail negative space so an overlay of 7 rows by 5 columns of square icons and pale labels reads clearly. Put identifiable objects only into narrow left/right margins and corners; fade scene depth softly into the centre. Keep bottom centre especially dark. Any brightest light belongs high at the top edge or upper corner, never bottom. No text, letters, symbols that resemble writing, logo, watermark, border frame, nodes, icons, diagram, connectors, graphic lines or UI. One continuous image, no panels. Tree Quarry, draft 2, 'Hunter's clearing'. A dim forest clearing on an early dawn ridge, deep moss green and muted earth brown. Tall grass close at the extreme left, a shed antler and pale feather half-cropped on the right edge, sparse dark tree silhouettes framing the outer edges. Subdued golden light high at upper right; broad centre remains smooth dark forest mist, no path lines.

post_processing.calm_centre: Smooth horizontal mask: zero at outer 5%, full from 18% to 82%; Gaussian blur radius 2 px and brightness 0.72 inside mask
post_processing.encoding: 256-colour MEDIANCUT palette, no dithering, PNG optimize=True
